feedback: The payroll export completes with a success badge, but new files contain bank details for workers in unrelated companies. One outside customer has already downloaded a file and the job still runs every ten minutes.
The public API is returning timeouts on all write requests in every region. Read requests still work, but clients cannot save any changes and failover has also timed out.
Two testers can make the app close by rotating a Pixel phone during video playback. It happens on the beta build only. The current production build plays the same video normally.

The report says this is the old badge issue. That issue concerns missing badges on web profiles. Support reproduced a different problem on the Android app where tapping the badge opens the wrong help article.
The purchasing team can find the right vendor using search. They want pinned suppliers at the top because they reorder from the same five vendors several times a day.
A request asks for a receipt preview before sending it. Sending works and has no reported errors. The accountant wants to catch misspelled company names before receipts reach customers.

The ticket owner checked the new trace and confirmed it matches RPT-603, where the quarterly chart label disappears with the same date filter. The patch is already in review. This report adds a second trace.
A tenant found the same icon overlap in the compact layout on build 12. The design lead confirmed it is covered by active issue DES-20 and still affects only that layout.
A support handover marks a customer issue critical and attaches a recording that cannot be opened. The only note is 'still blocked', with no task, screen, or error text.
An executive mentioned that onboarding needs attention. Nobody can tell which step caused friction, who encountered it, or what the desired outcome is.
消息界面仍显示发送成功，但后台审计发现付费客户的收件地址被串到其他客户，发送任务仍在执行，已有外部收件人收到私密附件。
九个分拨中心的司机都无法接收线路更新，调度台转发和备用电话同步均失败。今天的车队仍在等待路线。
检测到在 125% 系统缩放下点开草稿时，工具栏压住最后一项。研发在两台同配置设备验证，切回 100% 即可继续。
客户把现象归到已知的上传超时，支持同事复现后确认其实是文件名含问号时才报错。改名可上传，其他文件没受影响。
运动场预约可以正常完成。教练希望能复制上个月的固定时段，因为每周的训练安排几乎相同。
投递简历目前符合设计，每次选一个岗位。招聘方希望人才池支持保存常用搜索条件，避免每周重新搭筛选。
今天又收到平板端同样的按钮抖动。支持人员核对屏幕尺寸和操作路径，确认正在修复的 MBL-17 已涵盖，问题仍限同一分辨率。
第二个卖家提交标签打印错位录屏。工单负责人确认与 LABEL-55 的纸张尺寸、步骤和结果完全一致，原单继续跟踪。
群里说‘客户那边今天又不行了’，没有产品名、操作时间或录屏，暂时也找不到谁最先反馈。
有人提议优化提醒，但表格只有一句‘应该更好’，没有用户群、提醒场景或需要达成的目标。
